disposition: Progress and status records exist and are focused-tested across the transfer seams — bounded progress disclosures with exact totals, skipped items reported without hiding loss, typed schedule failures in status, sealed-bundle runs reporting no secrets, restore receipts disclosing counts/duplicates/memory bound, and the migration loss matrix; a /v1/metrics endpoint surfaces stream drops in the C# host.
